verdict.rationale: MoonPay documents an off-ramp that lets users 'turn crypto into cash' and get paid to a bank account or Visa card (docs-17, docs-23), and webhooks exist for sell transactions (docs-11, docs-12), but this is framed as a consumer-facing widget flow requiring per-transaction MFA login, not a documented merchant/finance-lead feature for auto-converting incoming stablecoin payments into a fiat balance or automated bank payout so books never hold crypto. Missing for 10: explicit merchant/business settlement docs, automated (non-interactive) stablecoin-to-fiat sweep/payout for received payments, and any treasury/balance-holding mechanism.
